# PETFEED :  Manual pet feed to avoid wastage even in ownwer’s absence

# Problem Statement

Pet owners may not always be available to feed their pets at the required time. This can lead to delayed or missed feeding. A simple automatic system is needed to dispense food with less manual effort.

# Solution

We designed an automatic pet food feeder using an ultrasonic sensor and servo motor. When the pet comes near the feeder, the ultrasonic sensor detects its presence. The servo motor then rotates to open the food outlet and releases a small amount of food. After a short time, the servo returns to its original position and closes the outlet.

# Working

The ultrasonic sensor continuously measures the distance.  
When a pet comes within the set distance, the sensor detects it.  
The servo motor rotates and opens the food container outlet.  
Food falls into the feeding tray.  
After a short delay, the servo closes the outlet.

## Materials Used

* Arduino UNO  
* HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor  
* SG90 Servo Motor  
* Jumper wires  
* Breadboard

## Advantages

🐕 Reduces the need for manual feeding.  
⏱️ Provides quick and automatic food dispensing.  
💰 Low-cost and simple to build.  
🔋 Can work with a small power supply.  
🛠️ Easy to maintain and modify.  
♻️ Can help control the amount of food released.
